description: This file contains helper functions for testing bitmap functionality within a Git repository, including setup routines, comparison utilities, and test scenarios for bitmap-related features, pack creation, and repository configurations.

methods.name: test_bitmap_traversal
methods.description: Normalizes and compares the traversal output of bitmap and non-bitmap Git rev-list commands.

methods.name: setup_bitmap_history
methods.description: Sets up a complex repository history with merges and branches for testing bitmap operations.

methods.name: rev_list_tests_head
methods.description: Runs a series of rev-list tests for a specific branch and state, validating bitmap counts.

methods.name: rev_list_tests
methods.description: Iterates over key branches to perform multiple rev-list and bitmap traversal tests.

methods.name: basic_bitmap_tests
methods.description: Performs fundamental bitmap tests including verification, cloning, partial cloning, and delta validation.

methods.name: have_delta
methods.description: Checks whether the specified object is a delta based on the expected base object.

methods.name: midx_pack_source
methods.description: Determines which pack file contains the specified object by reading the multi-pack index.

methods.name: test_rev_exists
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a reverse index for a given commit and kind.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_core
methods.description: Conducts core tests for creating and verifying multi-pack indexes with bitmaps, including various setup scenarios.

methods.name: midx_bitmap_partial_tests
methods.description: Performs tests on partial bitmap indexes in specific repository states.
